title: Purple-teaming LLMs with Adversarial Defender Training

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Attack Success Rate (ASR) using the 'Discrimination' subset of the SafetyPrompt dataset, which involves evaluating model responses to adversarial prompts aiming to elicit bias, stereotypes, or hate speech using an automated Judge model.

Zero-resource 'Scratch' setting evaluation where an LLM is prompted to automatically generate adversarial attack points specifically targeting the 'no gender bias' rule, followed by measuring the defense's Attack Success Rate (ASR).
